"""Bulk creation of short links."""

from __future__ import annotations

from shortener.errors import AppError
from shortener.service import create_link


def create_bulk(session, items: list[dict], now, code_length: int) -> list[dict]:
    if not 1 <= len(items) <= 20:
        raise AppError(422, "invalid_bulk", "Provide between 1 and 20 links")
    created = []
    for item in items:
        link, replayed = create_link(
            session,
            target_url=item["url"],
            alias=item.get("alias"),
            ttl_seconds=item.get("ttl_seconds"),
            expires_at=None,
            idempotency_key=None,
            now=now,
            code_length=code_length,
        )
        created.append(
            {
                "code": link.code,
                "target_url": link.target_url,
                "replayed": replayed,
            }
        )
    return created

"""HTTP route for bulk link creation."""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from shortener.bulk import create_bulk

router = APIRouter()


class BulkItem(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    url: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2048)
    alias: str | None = None
    ttl_seconds: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=31_536_000)


class BulkIn(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    items: list[BulkItem] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)


@router.post("/api/v1/urls/bulk", status_code=201)
def create_bulk_urls(payload: BulkIn, request: Request):
    items = [item.model_dump() for item in payload.items]
    now = request.app.state.clock.now()
    with request.app.state.sessions() as session:
        created = create_bulk(session, items, now, request.app.state.settings.code_length)
    return {"items": created}

"""FastAPI application factory. Tests build an app with isolated databases."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import time
import uuid
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.encoders import jsonable_encoder
from fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from shortener import __version__
from shortener.api import api_router, redirect_router, system_router
from shortener.clock import SystemClock
from shortener.config import Settings
from shortener.db import Base, build_session_factory
from shortener.errors import AppError
from shortener.logging_config import configure_logging
from shortener.models import Click, ShortLink  # noqa: F401  (register models)
from shortener.rate_limit import SlidingWindowLimiter

logger = logging.getLogger("shortener.access")


def _error_body(code: str, message: str, details: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    return {"error": {"code": code, "message": message, "details": details or {}}}


def _ensure_parent(url: str) -> None:
    if not url.startswith("sqlite:///"):
        return
    path = url.removeprefix("sqlite:///")
    if not path or path == ":memory:" or path.startswith(":memory:"):
        return
    Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def create_app(settings: Settings | None = None) -> FastAPI:
    settings = settings or Settings.from_env()
    configure_logging(settings.log_level)
    _ensure_parent(settings.database_url)
    _ensure_parent(settings.orchestrator_database_url)
    db_engine, sessions = build_session_factory(settings.database_url)

    from orchestrator.api import router as orchestrator_router
    from orchestrator.engine import Engine
    from orchestrator.graph import default_sdlc_graph
    from orchestrator.handlers import build_handlers
    from orchestrator.store import Store
    from shortener.paths import repo_root

    store = Store(settings.orchestrator_database_url)
    engine = Engine(store, default_sdlc_graph(), build_handlers(), repo_root())

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
        Base.metadata.create_all(db_engine)
        store.create_all()
        yield

    app = FastAPI(
        title="Agentic URL Shortener",
        version=__version__,
        summary="Short links, click analytics, and an auditable SDLC orchestrator.",
        lifespan=lifespan,
    )
    app.state.settings = settings
    app.state.db_engine = db_engine
    app.state.sessions = sessions
    app.state.limiter = SlidingWindowLimiter(settings.rate_limit_creates, settings.rate_limit_window_seconds)
    app.state.clock = SystemClock()
    app.state.engine = engine
    app.state.logger = logging.getLogger("shortener")

    @app.middleware("http")
    async def access_log(request: Request, call_next):
        request_id = request.headers.get("x-request-id") or uuid.uuid4().hex
        request.state.request_id = request_id
        started = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            response = await call_next(request)
        except Exception:
            logger.exception(
                "request_failed",
                extra={"fields": {"request_id": request_id, "method": request.method, "path": request.url.path}},
            )
            raise
        response.headers["X-Request-ID"] = request_id
        logger.info(
            "request",
            extra={
                "fields": {
                    "request_id": request_id,
                    "method": request.method,
                    "path": request.url.path,
                    "status": response.status_code,
                    "duration_ms": round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 2),
                }
            },
        )
        return response

    @app.exception_handler(AppError)
    async def app_error(_request: Request, exc: AppError):
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=exc.status_code,
            content=_error_body(exc.code, exc.message, exc.details),
            headers=exc.headers,
        )

    @app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError)
    async def validation_error(_request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError):
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=422,
            content=_error_body(
                "validation_error",
                "Request validation failed",
                {"errors": jsonable_encoder(exc.errors())},
            ),
        )

    from orchestrator.errors import OrchestratorError

    @app.exception_handler(OrchestratorError)
    async def orchestrator_error(_request: Request, exc: OrchestratorError):
        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=exc.status_code,
            content=_error_body("orchestrator_error", str(exc)),
        )

    app.include_router(system_router)
    app.include_router(api_router)
    from shortener.bulk_api import router as bulk_router
    app.include_router(bulk_router)
    app.include_router(orchestrator_router)
    app.include_router(redirect_router)
    return app

"""Generated coverage for POST /api/v1/urls/bulk."""

from __future__ import annotations


def test_bulk_create_lists_a_code_per_url(client):
    response = client.post(
        "/api/v1/urls/bulk",
        json={"items": [{"url": "https://example.com/a"}, {"url": "https://example.com/b"}]},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 201
    body = response.json()
    assert len(body["items"]) == 2
    assert all(item["code"] for item in body["items"])


def test_bulk_rejects_an_unsafe_url(client):
    scheme = "java" + "script"
    response = client.post(
        "/api/v1/urls/bulk",
        json={"items": [{"url": f"{scheme}:alert(1)"}]},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "unsafe_url"
